proposals.action_title: Launch First KDP Coloring Book with Aggressive Launch Pricing
proposals.why_this_works_now: The coloring book pipeline is near ready. Launching at $4.99 (minimal royalty) triggers the KDP 'New Release' algorithm boost and secures organic reviews before raising the price to $7.99.
proposals.first_action_today: Use the Together AI free tier (FLUX-schnell) to generate 25 high-contrast black and white animal coloring pages, compile them to PDF via Python/ReportLab on Termux, and submit to KDP.

proposals.action_title: Upload 100 Minimalist French Typography Designs on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Bypasses the image generation bottleneck completely. Text-based designs (e.g., regional French humor, developer jokes) have high conversion rates on stickers and mugs and require zero GPU budget.
proposals.first_action_today: Write a Python PIL script in Termux to batch-generate 100 high-resolution transparent PNGs of trending text slogans using free Google Fonts.

proposals.action_title: Publish 10 Functional Parametric 3D Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Functional 3D prints (cable organizers, custom gridfinity boxes, SD card holders) sell consistently to 3D printing enthusiasts. OpenSCAD code can be written directly on Android/Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Write an OpenSCAD script for a modular, stackable drawer organizer, render the STL, and list it on Cults3D for 1.99€.

proposals.action_title: Generate and Upload 15 No-Content/Low-Content KDP Logbooks
proposals.why_this_works_now: Zero-image dependency. Specialized logbooks (e.g., 'Hexagonal Graph Paper for Organic Chemistry', 'French Mileage Logbook / Suivi Kilométrique') have high search volume and low barrier to entry.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a 120-page grid PDF using Python's ReportLab on Termux and design a minimalist text-only cover on KDP Cover Creator.

proposals.action_title: Bundle Redbubble Designs into High-Value Sticker Packs
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble customers love sticker packs because they get 5-10 small stickers for the price of one medium sticker. It significantly boosts conversion rates.
proposals.first_action_today: Combine 6 of your generated minimalist text/icon PNGs into a single grid image with spacing, upload it as a 'Sticker Pack' on Redbubble.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 UI/UX Asset Packs on Itch.io for Game Devs
proposals.why_this_works_now: Game developers constantly buy cheap UI packs (buttons, icons, panels) to prototype. You can generate clean SVG UI elements via Python scripts on Termux.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate a pack of 50 flat-vector UI buttons in different colors using a Python SVG generation script, zip them, and list on Itch.io as 'Name Your Own Price' (suggested $1.99).
